subject: CAIQ evidence concierge: pen-test artifacts, scope reduction, and sample logs
messages:
From: Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Morris <audits@thirdpartysec.io>
Date: 2027-06-19 09:12 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping request + pen test artifacts

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our procurement for a Pilot rollout, Acme Health needs a compact CAIQ submission that ties each asserted control to an evidence artifact. We have three asks upfront: a) an assertion index spreadsheet that points to artifacts, b) a short pen-test executive summary we can include in our security package, and c) a set of redacted runtime log samples that demonstrate tenant isolation and key rotation events.

Can you confirm what you can provide by the end of next week? We have an internal review on 2027-06-30 and it would be ideal to have artifacts loaded to your Evidence Portal before then.

Also: a couple of controls need explicit notes about re-identification risk and how you handle PII in debug dumps — if you could include short caveats in the assertion index that would help our reviewers.

Cheers,
Leah Brooks
Director, Application Security
Acme Health

Attachment: scope_outline.pdf (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-19 10:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + pen test artifacts

Leah — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support the three deliverables. Proposed plan:

- CAIQ assertion index (excel): we will map each control to a one-line rationale + artifact link. We will call out PII redaction notes inline for controls where logs are used.
- Pen-test executive summary: redwood will provide a one-page summary of the recent third-party test (scope, high-level findings, status) and an attest signed by the testing vendor.
- Redacted runtime logs: we will provide 3 short, sanitized log excerpts showing tenant init/serve/rotation events.

Timeline (targeting your 6/30 review):
- 6/22 EOD: draft assertion index and pen-test executive summary (internal review)
- 6/23: upload initial artifacts to Evidence Portal and share links; send redaction notes
- 6/25: finalize items and submit DocuSign attestation if required

Jonas, can you coordinate the Evidence Portal upload and confirm the redaction patterns we will apply? Kimberly, I want you to own the assertion wording for the tenant/isolation controls (S2.6 / S3.* in our mapping).

Marissa
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial-action-items.md (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-20 08:46 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + pen test artifacts

Quick internal notes and owner assignments:

- Assertion index: I'll draft mappings for controls related to data residency, key management, and runtime isolation. I'll include short caveats about pseudonymization controls where relevant.
- Logs: we'll produce three redaction flavors: (A) full redaction of PII tokens, (B) token-hash-only, (C) time-series stripped aggregated events. Each sample will have a one-line description.
- Pen test summary: I'm looping in Kyle (external) to request the vendor-signed summary and a short scope file.

Leah — expect the first draft of the assertion index as an .xlsx on 6/22. I'm keeping the wording minimal so it can slot directly into your Security package.

Kimberly
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redaction-rules.txt (referenced)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-23 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Evidence portal upload + sample links

Hi all — upload update:

- I've published a draft CAIQ assertion index to the Evidence Portal: https://evidence.redwood.com/requests/ACME-1122/artifacts/idx-20270623 (portal requires access; Marissa — please confirm external link is viewable by Leah).
- Uploaded artifacts: CAIQ-assertion-index.xlsx, pen-test-summary.pdf (vendor attestation pending), sample-runtime-logs-redacted.txt
- Checklist: evidence-upload-checklist.md has the list of what we redacted and why.

Leah — the pen-test vendor has one outstanding findings response we're waiting on. Kyle from ThirdPartySec confirmed he'll send the signed executive summary by EOD tomorrow (6/24).

Follow-ups:
- If Acme needs a notarized DocuSign attestation that we executed the redaction strategy, we can circulate the PowerForm link (included below).
- I'll also export a minimal JSON mapping (control -> artifact id) if you prefer machine-readable imports.

Jonas
Lead Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: portal-upload-log.txt (stub)

From: Kyle Morris <audits@thirdpartysec.io>
To: Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-24 09:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + pen test artifacts

Marissa / Leah — attaching the signed pen-test executive summary and the scope file. We flagged one medium item (certificate rotation cadence) which Redwood has already scheduled a remediation in 2 weeks.

Please let me know if you need the full report exchanged under an NDA — otherwise the exec summary should be sufficient for procurement review.

Attachment: pen-test-summary.pdf, pen-test-scope.json (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Brooks <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-23 16:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence concierge: pen-test artifacts, scope reduction, and sample logs

Leah — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround from Kyle. Final notes for Acme's package:

- We uploaded the CAIQ-assertion-index.xlsx with inline caveats for PII and redaction patterns (cells in column D).
- Pen-test executive summary (signed) attached to the Evidence Portal; full report available under NDA if you need deeper detail.
- Sample runtime logs show tenant initialization, KV key-rotation event and a successful failover — each excerpt includes the redaction annotation header.

Next steps we propose: 1) You preview the Evidence Portal bundle and send confirmation to procurement; 2) If you require the DocuSign attestation, follow this PowerForm: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345678&pf=CAIQ-Attest; 3) We will mark the HubSpot deal as "security-ready" once you confirm.

Marissa
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded: CAIQ-assertion-index.xlsx, pen-test-summary.pdf, sample-runtime-logs-redacted.txt, evidence-upload-checklist.md
